clientBasic.description: Confidential application ID and secret. Never use in a browser.

deviceAccess.description: Short-lived access token obtained through an approved device-code grant.

installationSecret.description: Installation-scoped management secret stored only on the local installation.

adminSession.name: fastcas_session
adminSession.description: Administrator browser session with recent MFA. POST additionally needs exact Origin and X-CSRF-Token.

browserSession.name: fastcas_session
browserSession.description: Ordinary FastCAS browser session. POST additionally needs exact Origin and X-CSRF-Token.

RegisteredDeviceInstallation.description: The management secret is returned once and only authorizes reading/revoking this installation.

CreateApplication.description: Redirect URIs are required for authorization_code; service-only clients need nonempty scopes and resources and should use /admin/service-accounts.

OneTimeSecret.description: The credential is returned once and never included in list responses.
